assessments.summary: Conditional on the expressly assumed Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 outer-bound premise supplied by the declared dependency, the exact row combination, posterior reduction, continuous-domain directed-interval weak-duality certificate, all-prior maximization, and terminal verifier attestation establish the stated interval for U. Its upper endpoint is strictly below 0.369296945969202842443, proving C_sum <= 0.369296945969202842443 for the fixed auxiliary-receiver pair.
scopeQualifications: The cited Theorem 9 premise is assumed and is not authenticated or independently re-proved.
The conclusion applies only to the specified fixed receiver pair and supplied dual certificate.
No receiver optimality or dual optimality is established.
No matching achievable rate or exact BSSC sum-capacity is established.
All displayed receiver probabilities are treated as exact decimals.
